answer: Accounts under 30 epochs old share one 90-credit pool per epoch, split by the ledger. Joining burns 15 credits times one plus the number of accounts admitted in the last 600 epochs. Beside 8 honest newcomers, such as an agent rerouting quill cargo from a gale-shut wharf, a farm's n-th fake gains 21600/((8+n)(7+n)) credits but burns 15(8+n), so the fourth gains 164 and pays 180. Waiting out a cohort resets nothing, because that count is chain history.
